note: The SHARED fixture for the UCT Relative Strength Learn links (engineering map 2026-11-06 §2.8 / §3 row 2a-16; design spec 2026-11-05 §6.11). Six lesson keys the RS About readout (2a-10) links to, each a Desk video id plus a seek in seconds (decision D6, 2026-11-07: the chapter covering relative strength where the repo holds chapter data, otherwise 1 so the link opens the lesson at its top rather than the member's resume point; deskVideoHref.js records which rows got which start). Mirrored by app/src/lib/deskVideoHref.js RS_LEARN_VIDEOS (the JS lane reads this file in deskVideoHref.test.js); tests/test_rs_learn_seed.py pins every youtube_id against api/services/education_seed.py SEED_VIDEOS so a regenerated seed sheet cannot drop a target silently. Not an indicator-math case: no bars, no expected columns.
